Describe the behavior and expected result. Include exact OctoPrint, Python,
USB Relay Control, MQTT and companion versions. State whether hardware is real
or synthetic and whether the environment is authorized for this test.

Provide minimal reproduction steps and tests actually run. Do not upload server
configuration, broker passwords, account tokens or personal filesystem paths.
Security vulnerabilities require private reporting; see SECURITY.md.
